erin: Hey! New hire here. Following the Node quickstart (npm install @redwood/sdk && node examples/hello.js) but getting a 403 with a weird body: `{
  "error": "workspace_region_mismatch",
  "message": "Request region does not match workspace region."
}`. The account billing looks active. Any ideas?

rafael: welcome! quick checks: which SDK version? and are you using REDWOOD_API_HOST or REDWOOD_REGION env? The SDK recently started defaulting to `us` region for older installs.

erin: SDK version is 0.9.1 (installed via the quickstart README steps). I didn't set any region env. The example calls `client.generate({input: 'hi'})` so I assumed default host would be fine.

nina: ah that explains it. v0.9.x predates per-region hosts. We added region-aware hosts in v1.0. The backend returns that region mismatch 403 when a token is valid but bound to an EU workspace and the request goes to the US endpoint. Two options: upgrade SDK to latest (recommended) or set REDWOOD_API_HOST to `https://eu.api.redwood.ai`.

erin: thanks! upgrading to `@redwood/sdk@^1.2.0` fixed it — got 200 and the example prints a generation. Quick note: the quickstart instructions still show `npm install @redwood/sdk` without a version; that pulled the older pinned package for some reason in the template.

rafael: hmm, the quickstart Dockerfile/template pins `@redwood/sdk@latest` in our starter project generator but the README `npm install` snippet in docs is stale. We should sync. Also add an explicit `REDWOOD_API_HOST` mention in the remarks for users in regulated regions.

ops-bot: Audit log: New developer `erin` created first successful request to workspace-wxyz at 2026-03-22T12:07:04Z.

nina: follow-ups: 1) add a short troubleshooting FAQ for `workspace_region_mismatch` with two checks (SDK version, REDWOOD_API_HOST/REDWOOD_REGION). 2) add a one-liner in the quickstart script that warns if SDK < 1.0: `node -e "const v=require('child_process').execSync('node -p \"require(\'./node_modules/@redwood/sdk/package.json\').version\"').toString().trim(); if(v.split('.')[0]<1) console.warn('Your @redwood/sdk is <1.0 — upgrade to avoid region routing issues');"` 3) mark the docs page to recommend `npm install @redwood/sdk@^1.2.0` for now.

erin: all good — upgraded and unblocked. happy to file the quickstart PR if you want.

devx-bot: Created ticket DX-498: "Quickstart: Node SDK version/region mismatch causes 403 (workspace_region_mismatch)". Assigned to docs + devex. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DX-498 :white_check_mark:

rafael: thanks erin — can you paste the exact 403 JSON and your `node -v` so we can reproduce on CI?\nerin: sure: `node -v` => v18.16.0. 403 JSON pasted above. I'll attach a tiny repro repo in the ticket. Thanks everyone :v:
